architectural_fidelity.reason: Bay window configuration, ceiling height, wall color/finish, baseboards, and camera angle all preserved accurately; room is immediately recognizable as the same space

furniture_removal.reason: Room is completely empty with no furniture remnants, ghost outlines, or phantom shadows; clean base achieved

style_commitment.reason: COVAMINIMAL style not executed—room shows a few small plants and basic framed photos but lacks any distinct minimal design conviction; reads as generic empty room, not a styled minimal aesthetic

editorial_density.reason: Severely under-styled: only window sill plants and 3 small wall photos visible; no furniture, no textiles, no layered vignettes, no multiple light sources, no lived-in details—this is empty staging, not editorial

photorealism.reason: Natural lighting through windows is coherent, wood floor texture realistic, wall finishes proper, shadows accurate; no CGI or plastic appearance

designer_preference_reason: Collov delivers a fully realized, styled space with furniture and editorial density that I could present to clients, while Cova's output is an empty room unsuitable for staging purposes
what_cova_does_better: Natural photographic quality without artificial enhancement
what_collov_does_better: Editorial-level styling with layered textiles and accessories
Multiple coordinated decor elements creating cohesive design narrative
Professional staging density appropriate for client presentation
specific_fixes_if_failing: Add complete furniture suite appropriate for living room (sofa, chairs, coffee table, side tables)
Include minimum 3-4 layered textiles (throw pillows, blankets, area rug)
Add editorial styling vignettes on surfaces with books, objects, decorative items
Install statement lighting fixture and table/floor lamps
Incorporate larger-scale plants beyond window sill
Add substantial wall art program with properly scaled pieces
Execute clear minimal design language with intentional material palette and forms
